children: Vera Bradley, Inc. reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $71.65M and diluted EPS of $0.15, marking modest revenue growth and a return to profitability versus a net loss in the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Net revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Diluted net income (loss) per share”.
Revenue growth was modest: net revenues rose 1.1% for the quarter and 4.0% year-to-date, driven by strength in the Direct channel.
Direct channel performance was strong, with comparable direct sales up 9.2% for the quarter and 10.9% YTD; Indirect channels declined as marketplace strategy timing weighed on results.
Brand initiatives including Project Sunshine and licensed IP collaborations (Disney, Peanuts) supported e‑commerce growth and customer engagement.

Operational improvements included lower SG&A from reduced advertising and cost optimization, improved gross margins aided by tariff refunds, and a stable store base (112 stores) with Outlet 2.0 repositioning for better profitability.
